content.text: The single flag points at the composite-construction paragraph and asserts a C3 deficiency. The draft's returns table presents 1-year, 5-year, 10-year **and** since-inception (Oct. 1, 2004) figures, gross and net, so the 1/5/10-year requirement is already satisfied on its face. The quoted passage is boilerplate methodology disclosure (minimum account size, inception date, time-weighting, fee treatment) and carries no performance results of its own. It is neither of the unmatched known issues — p1 is the "principal is safe / protect capital in every market environment" absolute claim in the opening section, and p2 is the backtested Tactical Duration model, both in different parts of the document.

flags.note: C3 is already met: the annualized returns table shows 1-year, 5-year, 10-year and since-inception (Oct. 1, 2004) figures, in both gross and net form, plus ten years of calendar-year returns. The flagged text is the composite-construction and calculation methodology paragraph, which contains no performance results at all and therefore cannot present periods shorter than ten years. No checklist code is triggered by this passage; it is in fact supporting disclosure. Does not correspond to p1 (absolute capital-protection claim) or p2 (backtested Tactical Duration model).
